title: Senior Manager, Weatherization Quality & Technical Services
text:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

The mission of the Colorado Energy Office (CEO) is to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and consumer energy costs by advancing clean energy, energy efficiency, and zero emission vehicles to benefit all Coloradans. We do this by developing and implementing highly impactful policies and programs, establishing Colorado as a leading state for climate action. The Colorado Energy Office is a great place to work, with collaborative and talented employees who are passionate about our mission and a hybrid atmosphere. Employees report high satisfaction with their work, their colleagues and manager, and CEO leadership. Join us!

 
 

Reducing greenhouse gas pollution and advancing zero emission vehicles, energy efficiency and clean energy are essential to preserving and protecting Colorado’s way of life. These actions defend the health of our communities and natural environment, provide access to lower cost clean energy resources for rural and urban areas, increase investment and economic growth opportunities, and expand clean energy jobs. As part of our mission we serve the people of Colorado with programs focusing on weatherization, energy efficiency, and electric vehicles and a regulatory and legislative agenda to promote the interests of all Coloradans.

 
 

***We are committed to increasing the diversity of our staff and providing culturally responsive programs and services. Therefore, we encourage responses from people of all backgrounds and abilities.***

**Description of Job**
----------------------

* **This is a hybrid position. Hybrid positions are required to be present at the office location for a minimum of two days per work week during the first 90 days, and minimum one to two days a week after that, or as directed by office leadership.**

CEO’s Weatherization Assistance Program (WAP), helps qualified Coloradans save money, increase comfort, and better their homes and environment through proven energy conservation solutions.These solutions include LED light bulbs, high efficiency furnaces and refrigerators, building shell insulation, and rooftop solar arrays, among others.

 
 

CEO is hiring for a visionary Senior Manager, Weatherization Quality & Technical Services to join the WAP team. You will serve as a strategic leader, bridging advanced building science with organizational excellence. This role is pivotal in shaping how we deliver sustainable energy solutions to diverse communities across Colorado, turning technical compliance into a platform for continuous improvement and innovation.

The WAP network spans all 64 Colorado counties, delivering critical energy efficiency and clean energy solutions to diverse populations through a network of six subgrantee agencies. As the Senior Manager, you will step into a high-impact, supervisory role overseeing a team of technical experts located around the state who serve as the definitive authority on residential building science, ensuring weatherization work meets performance standards through on-site inspections, detailed reporting, and training, while also acting as an internal and network consultant to streamline operations, drive process improvement, and ensure program delivery is transparent and visible.

 
 

In this senior-level manager capacity, you will blend advanced building science knowledge with administrative leadership and process optimization.

WAP Specific Duties and Responsibilities

* Lead the Quality Management team, which includes Technical & QCI Quality Management staff in completing all necessary BPI certified Quality Assurance Inspections (typically 50-75/yr) and Quality Control visits (typically 20-30/yr) across Colorado to meet all federal and state statutory and programmatic requirements
* Balance the team’s core focus (QA, QC, & training) with opportunities for ongoing innovation.
* Drive strategic quality management through Quality Control and Assurance (QC & QA), transforming federal guidelines into accessible, actionable insights that empower our subgrantee network
* Cultivate a high-performing team by providing mentorship and leadership that fosters a collaborative, inclusive environment where technical experts can thrive and innovate
* Partner with other CEO WAP teams to integrate quality management operational outcomes with targeted training to drive continuous, lasting enhancements across the program
* Lead the QM team in partnering with other CEO WAP teams to develop and deliver targeted, hands-on guidance to local subgrantee organizations undergoing leadership shifts or performance remediation, ensuring full alignment with state and federal guidelines, state program implementation strategies, and complementary clean energy initiatives
* Champion Operational Excellence by collaborating cross-functionally with other CEO WAP teams to identify bottlenecks, modernize our workflows, and scale our program’s reach
* Provide immediate support to subgrantees to address critical safety hazards detected during site evaluations or staff reviews, escalating severe concerns to WAP Director when subgrantee remediation or corrective action is warranted
* Work with the rest of the WAP team on QM production metrics from subgrantee agencies, auditing subgrantee performance for integrity and collaborating cross-functionally to report key outcomes to program leadership, federal partners, state administrators, and legislative bodies
* Influence Program Strategy by serving as a key advisor in creating WAP policy, translating real-world QM data into meaningful policy updates that increase program equity and effectiveness
* Modernize Tooling by leading the integration and management of platforms like monday.com to create transparent, streamlined project tracking systems and program delivery improvements.
* Participate in national and regional WAP events hosted by national associations to learn from and elevate the work of Colorado WAP

General Duties and Responsibilities

* Adhere to all technical and health and safety policies and procedures in the planning and execution of activities
* Maintain positive working relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders including WAP subgrantee agency staff, CEO Ops and Finance team, Federal Department of Energy partners, among others
* Abide by office policies and procedures in a manner that ensures fiscal responsibility and promotes efficient, effective, and elegant government.
* Use application software (i.e. word processing, spreadsheet, database, project management software, etc.) to prepare correspondence, plans, reports, schedules, and other documents
* Assist other CEO departments in carrying out unit and office wide priorities.
* Perform other duties as requested and required

**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------

We are looking for an experienced manager who pairs technical building science awareness with sophisticated team leadership expertise and continuous improvement approach.

Minimum Qualifications

* Minimum 2 years of direct supervisory experience OR similar translatable experience (indirect supervision like volunteer management, mentorship, vendor or contractor management)
* Minimum three years of working, inspection, and/or training experience in weatherization, residential energy efficiency services, or closely related field

Skills and Knowledge 
 

* Demonstrated ability to use the virtual collaboration strategies and tools necessary to lead a distributed team
* Demonstrated experience tracking compliance, reviewing staff reporting, and processing/approving invoices
* Dedicated to continuous improvement, desire to learn new skills
* Demonstrated leadership and facilitation capabilities
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on developing strong relationships
* Ability to independently start and finish tasks
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Strong written, oral, and presentation communication skills
* Willingness to adapt to and enhance current team culture
* Proficient in the following:

 + Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Gmail, Calendar, etc.) or Microsoft equivalent
 + Video conferencing software (Zoom, Google Meet, MS Teams, etc.)
* Experience and/or a willingness to use AI tools and best practices to inform programs and program management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Direct supervisory experience in the last five years
* Possession of or ability to obtain the Quality Control Inspector (QCI) certification within twelve months of hire date, see this PDF download for more information
* Experience using Salesforce
* Project Management software experience (i.e. Monday.com, Asana, etc.)
* Professional experience in sustainability, climate policy, or clean energy

 
Interested in learning more about:

* Process Improvement Methodologies (i.e Lean/Six Sigma)
* Total Quality Management (TQM)
* Colorado Energy Industry
